headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 29, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a thrilling 6-5 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Kyle Manzardo leading the charge at the plate. Manzardo's impressive performance included a home run and 4 RBIs. In other news, the Detroit Tigers dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 14-0 victory. Eduardo Valencia led the Orioles' offense with 4 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Curtis Mead of the Boston Red Sox, Byron Buxton of the Minnesota Twins, Cole Sulser of the Tampa Bay Rays, Vinnie Pasquantino of the Kansas City Royals, Casey Schmitt of the San Francisco Giants, Beck Way of the Kansas City Royals, Cole Sands of the Minnesota Twins, and Kerry Carpenter of the Detroit Tigers.

The Pittsburgh Pirates made a significant trade, acquiring Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The San Diego Padres signed SS Nu'u Contrades, while the St. Louis Cardinals traded RHP Scott Blewett to the Athletics for cash. The Chicago White Sox acquired RHP José Urquidy from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for RHP Felix Doroteo. The Boston Red Sox traded LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals for 3B Curtis Mead.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Guardians 2-0**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 2-0. JJ Bleday led the Reds' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Orioles 14-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 14-0 victory. Eduardo Valencia led the Orioles' offense with 4 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Edge Pirates in Thrilling 8-7 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a hard-fought 8-7 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Brandon Lowe leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Brandon Pfaadt pitched 7 strong innings, allowing 0 earned runs and striking out 4 batters.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 6-8 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a hard-fought win over the Philadelphia Phillies, with multiple players making significant contributions to the team's success. Impact hitters for the Marlins included Trea Turner, Justin Crawford, Otto Lopez, Heriberto Hernández, Esteury Ruiz, and Griffin Conine.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a 3-0 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Gabriel Moreno and Max Kepler contributing to the winning effort. Jared Triolo also made an impact in the game.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Place Curtis Mead on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Boston Red Sox third baseman Curtis Mead has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left wrist fracture, effective retroactive to July 28, 2026.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Rodríguez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles, who received cash in return.
